scripts.start: npx omega clean && npx omega setup && npm run gulp --
scripts.build: npx omega clean && npx omega setup && npx cross-env OMEGA_BUILD_MODE=true npm run gulp -- build
scripts.package: npx omega clean && npx omega setup && npx cross-env OMEGA_BUILD_MODE=true npm run gulp -- packageBuild
scripts.package:quick: npx omega clean && npx omega setup && npx cross-env OMEGA_BUILD_MODE=true npm run gulp -- packageQuick
scripts.publish: npx cross-env OMEGA_BUILD_MODE=true OMEGA_IS_PUBLISH=true npm run gulp -- publish
scripts.release:local: npx omega clean && npx omega setup && npx cross-env OMEGA_BUILD_MODE=true OMEGA_IS_PUBLISH=true npm run gulp -- publish
